system.traits: Special; all who hear must pass DN 4:2 Mind (Resolve) or be Frightened
system.description: One of twelve ever made, each built from the bones of twelve sacrificed people. Duplicates Level 2–4 Banishing and Exorcism. Deals S+3 damage each round played; the player takes 1 damage per round. Activating effects needs a Spirit (Zeal) roll. Requisition DN 6:3; Certification COWEU Level 3+, Training (2) Presence, Virtuoso Talent.
